rationale: Initial roadmap planned 177 modules but only 69 shipped (39%). Phase 4-5 script files exist as placeholders but contain no working code. Must be explicit about this to avoid wasting time on stubs.
alternatives: Delete stub scripts entirely — loses planning artifacts

decision: L1/L2/L3 CLAUDE.md hierarchy for plugin project
rationale: Context is depletable. Plugin has 6 skills + 170 scripts. Flat CLAUDE.md forced re-reading 159 lines every session. L1 router + L2 per skill + L3 docs = faster routing, lower context cost.
alternatives: Keep flat CLAUDE.md — simpler to write, but slower to navigate
Use .claude/rules/ with path patterns — more precise but requires more files

decision: Hooks validate version consistency (plugin.json ≠ CHANGELOG = block commit)
rationale: Past incident: published v5.0.0 in plugin.json but CHANGELOG said v4.9.0. Users confused. Mechanical validation prevents this.
alternatives: Just document the rule — relies on discipline
Auto-update plugin.json from CHANGELOG — breaks intentional version control
